title: CoordBook
description: In-game coordinate notebook, sorted by world.
body:
📖 CoordBook

Advanced, highly-optimized in-game coordinate manager and waypoint tracker.

Developed by Markesr

--- ## 🔍 What is CoordBook? **CoordBook** is a sleek, modern, and high-performance client-side mod that completely eliminates the need for physical notepads or alt-tabbing to save your Minecraft coordinates. Simply press **`B`** to open a beautifully designed, dark-themed UI where you can record, categorize, and manage your important locations. From diamond mines to your secret base, your coordinates are always just a keystroke away. ### ⚡ Technical Excellence & Performance * **Modern Translucent UI:** Goodbye, clunky vanilla book textures! CoordBook features a premium, semi-transparent dark mode interface with clean borders and modern typography. * **Zero-Lag Architecture:** Carefully engineered with strict memory management. Pinned coordinates are cached efficiently, completely avoiding Java Garbage Collector stuttering (micro-lags) during rendering. * **Smart World Detection:** The mod intelligently groups your coordinates. It natively detects whether you are in a single-player world or a multiplayer server, ensuring your lists are always perfectly organized and separated based on your current location. --- ### 🛠️ Advanced Features * 📌 **Dynamic HUD Tracking:** Pin any coordinate from your book to have it appear directly on your screen (top right). The HUD dynamically calculates the real-time distance and displays an intelligent compass arrow pointing exactly to your saved location. * 📋 **One-Click Actions:** * **Copy:** Instantly copy formatted coordinates to your clipboard to share in chat. * **TP (Teleport):** If you have operator/admin permissions, a single click will instantly teleport you to the saved location. * **Categories:** Sort your coordinates by custom tags (e.g., "Mining", "Base", "Spawners") with easy-to-use filter tabs. * 🌍 **Dimension Awareness:** Automatically detects and saves the dimension (Overworld, Nether, End) and color-codes them within the UI for quick visual recognition. ### 📥 Dependencies To use this mod, please make sure you have the following installed in your mods folder: * [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) * *(Works entirely client-side! You do not need to install this on the server.)* ---
Enjoying the mod? Don't forget to follow CoreStudio for future projects!
